caption_metadata:
8,479 likes, 136 comments - adidasbike on October 4, 2026: "5x World Series overall wins, 5x World Champion titles in a row - a season to remember 🏆👑

A special message for Downhill World Champion Vali Höll, from someone who was by her side through every high and low ❤️🎤

swipe to hear @mathilde_gremaud’s voice note to her partner @valihoell after an incredible year 🫶

the numbers continue to impress, but this season has been about so much more ✨

#YouGotThis".
